mentions.name: writtenhuman.com
mentions.description: This web tool lets an author prove that a piece of text, a post, or a message was written by them: the author types the text into a box while typing metrics are captured (plausibility score, mean and peak words per minute, keystroke cadence, duration), producing a 'Verified human' receipt at a shareable link that others can use to validate the text by pasting it together with its stats block.
mentions.problem: The default has shifted toward machine-written text, so it is increasingly hard to prove that a message was actually written by a human; the author considers this a real problem with the potential to become a global crisis.
mentions.audience: Authors and people posting text online who want to prove their writing is human-made
mentions.source_excerpt: A simple way to prove that a piece of text, a post, a message, was written by me.

evidence.value: A simple way to prove that a piece of text, a post, a message, was written by me.
